Tooltip_AutoDoorMotor: A combined signal receiver and electric motor. Install it on an unlocked garage door, fence gate or a door you built yourself: the unit is placed on the ground next to the door and pairs with your remote. Requires a battery to work: every open/close consumes charge. Replace the battery from the door's menu when it runs out.
Tooltip_AutoDoorMagazine: Reading it teaches you how to craft the auto door remote and the auto door motor recipes.
